synopsis: core card-based RPG system 'Factorial 52!', uses standard 52-card deck for all checks and combat

body.description: Card-based tabletop RPG system. All actions resolved by drawing cards. No dice needed - only standard 52-card deck.
body.core_principle: Cards are drawn BEFORE player declares action. GM sees results and uses them for narrative. Player describes intent, GM interprets based on drawn cards.
body.card_drawing: Always draw 2 cards as a pair. Bot draws 2 pairs (4 cards) per turn for flexibility.

links.Значение_Карт: card rank values and face card meanings
links.Особые_События: special results from aces, twos, face cards

synopsis: card rank values: 2-10 face value, J=11, Q=12, K=13, A=15
four card suits correspond to four character stats

suits.♠ Spades: Strength/Power - physical might, close combat, intimidation, willpower
suits.♥ Hearts: Gift - unique ability, magical defense, wisdom, communication
suits.♦ Diamonds: Resilience - physical defense, endurance, charisma, trading
suits.♣ Clubs: Precision - ranged combat, acrobatics, accuracy, stealth

body.matching_bonus: +10 when card suit matches characteristic being tested

stats.♠ Strength (Spades): Physical power, close combat, intimidation, willpower

body.suit_matching: If card suit matches stat, add +10 bonus
